about: SFMTA (San Francisco Muni): look up routes, stops, real-time arrival predictions, vehicle locations, trip updates, service alerts and stop relocations through the JSON APIs behind sfmta.com.

commands.summary: List all Muni routes from the GTFS feed: route id, number, name, hours description and color.
List recent Muni service alerts (delays, reroutes, all-clears) with publish time and affected route tags.
Real-time arrival predictions (minutes, vehicle, direction, occupancy) for every route serving a stop, by public 5-digit stop code.

params.name: stopCode
params.description: Public 5-digit stop code shown at the stop and in URLs, e.g. 17954 (GTFS stop_code)

commands.summary: Live vehicle positions on a route: vehicle id, direction, lat/lon, speed, occupancy and time since last report.

params.name: routeId
params.description: Route id (short name), e.g. 38, 38R, 22, N, KT

commands.summary: Get GTFS details of one route: number, name, service hours description, type, color and links.
List all stops served by a route with stop id, public stop code, name and coordinates.
Route configuration with its directions (inbound/outbound names and ordered stop ids) and all stops with codes and coordinates.
Look up a stop by public stop code: title, sfmta.com page URL, location, internal stop id and the routes serving it with their direction names.
Get GTFS details of a stop by internal stop id (stop code without the leading 1): name, code, coordinates, wheelchair boarding.

params.name: stopId
params.description: Internal GTFS stop_id, usually 4 digits (e.g. 7954 for stop code 17954)

commands.summary: List the routes that serve a stop (by internal stop id), with route names and service hours.
GTFS-realtime trip updates (vehicle, headsign, per-stop predicted arrival times and delays in seconds) for a public stop code or a route id.

params.name: id
params.description: Public 5-digit stop code (e.g. 17954) or route id (e.g. 22, 38R)

commands.summary: Active GTFS-realtime service alerts affecting a route (empty list when none).
Active GTFS-realtime service alerts affecting a stop, by public stop code (empty list when none).
Route notes posted by SFMTA (service hours, frequency, special notices) as HTML snippets.
Stop notes posted by SFMTA (relocations, closures, notices) for an internal stop id.

params.name: stopId
params.description: Internal GTFS stop_id, usually 4 digits (stop code without leading 1), e.g. 7915

commands.summary: The single most recent Muni service alert plus the count of alerts in the last two days.
Route shape as a GeoJSON MultiLineString feature (coordinates as [lon, lat]) with route properties.
Feed of temporary Muni bus stop relocations/closures (stop, routes affected, dates, alternate stop).
